title: No-tax repair-gated re-test: bulk-materialized localized repair vs cold re-derivation with breadth and recurrence scaling
question: Once the carrier per-episode registry-materialization tax is removed (single bulk replace) and the frozen driver gate defect is repaired, is reuse-based localized repair strictly cheaper than cold re-derivation at L=2 and L=3 on both timed boundaries (inclusive and S-ARG-subtracted NOARG), and how does the margin scale with inheritance breadth (n=1,2,5 registered mechanisms) and recurrence (amortized N*)?
hypothesis: H1 (functional/locality gates, re-attested): after a single LOCAL perturbation, bulk-materialized reuse-based signal-driven local repair restores success on ALL FIVE TASK_IDS at rate >= 0.80 per class (Wilson lower >= 0.60), guard fires >= 0.80, write_set_max <= 1, same-target contamination <= 0.10 over 48 in-support unaffected probes per class (144 total), overbroad instrument fires > 0.10. H2 (shipped counter, deterministic drift-checked premise): under the shipped 4-field unit counter (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts, unit weights, zero fitted quantities), reuse charges exactly 17 units vs cold 18 (L=2) / 19 (L=3) by arm protocol on every functional_ok trial (parent vectors P1/P3 (6,5,5,1), P2 (5,5,6,1) vs cold (8,5,5,0)/(9,5,5,0)); H2 has zero empirical variance by construction and is checked as V-DRIFT-COLD (repair-independent cold nominals) + V-DRIFT-REUSE (successful-repaired reuse trials) + reported V-EQ-HOLDS, never claimed as an empirical win. H3 (end-to-end latency, the empirical decider): median timed-episode latency ratio reuse/cold is robustly below 1.00 at BOTH L=2 and L=3 under BOTH the inclusive timed boundary AND the S-ARG-subtracted NOARG boundary, on every perturbation class, where robustly means the Bonferroni family-wise-corrected bootstrap CI (1-0.05/12 over 12 class x L x boundary cells, B=10000) lies strictly below 1.00. H4 (breadth/recurrence scaling, descriptive only): the reuse-vs-cold margin is reported at inheritance breadths n=1 (target-only registration, the mandate's second authorized repair), n=2 and n=5 (bulk replace, the gated treatment), plus a derived recurrence crossover N* = learn_cost/(cold_med - reuse_med) per L and boundary (null when the denominator is <= 0). H5 (B3): model_calls/model_tokens are structurally 0 (no LLM endpoint on substrate); real model-call/token economics is UNSATISFIABLE here, priced in counters only, blocker recorded. H6 (treatment identity): the bulk registry content is exactly the upsert-built content (V-REG-EQUIV byte/content pin per trial plus a DESIGN byte-equality canary), so the repair changes only materialization cost, never treatment semantics.
falsifier: The re-admission claim FAILS toward PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED (reuse permanently dropped from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story on this substrate/carrier/classes/counter, no further L-sweeps, mandate stop trigger fires) if, with H1 functional/locality gates holding and no cold/reuse nominal drift, ANY of the 12 gated cells (3 classes x L=2/L=3 x inclusive/NOARG) is a robust LOSS (median ratio >= 1.00 with Bonferroni CI lower bound >= 1.00). It FAILS differently (FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL: bounded mechanism concern, no re-admit, no permanent drop) if functional/locality soundness itself breaks. It FAILS to decide (INCONCLUSIVE: no re-admit, no permanent drop, thread parked) on any MARGINAL cell without a LOSS (near-1.00 straddle), any missing ratio/CI (COST-UNKNOWN), or any tripped validity gate (MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a negative). The shipped-premise deficit path (reuse != 17 without cold drift) routes to PRICED-DEFICIT/DROP only via a robust latency LOSS; a pure shipped-count deviation without cold drift is a reuse-side anomaly and routes to MEASUREMENT_INVALID via V-DRIFT-REUSE (fail-safe sequencing pin; genuine repair failures are exempt by construction). Breadth/recurrence diagnostics (H4) and attribution (tie set) are reported and can never flip the gated decision.

Ungated diagnostic variants at breadth n=1 (target-only registration, the mandate's second authorized repair) and n=2 run the identical episode on deterministic breadth subsets (target + first sorted others); S-ARG still deepcopies the full dict so breadth scaling isolates to S-REGISTRY-BUILD.

null_control.protocol: NC-NO-PERTURBATION: guard on unperturbed body must be fresh (stale=false). NC-NOISE: observed_at churn must not fire. Per-trial fresh-silence: read-only guard on the unperturbed body in EVERY trial pre-perturbation (36 probes, untimed). NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR: target repaired postconditions applied to ALL mechanisms; in-support probe on 4 unaffected resources must flag breakage (>0.10). V-CLOSURE: sum of preregistered phase timings must reconstruct each timed episode within 20% (median per class). B-NO-REPAIR vacuity disclosed (see baselines): gate retained, diagnostic only.
null_control.success_criterion: NC-NO-PERTURBATION stale=false AND NC-NOISE stale=false AND pooled fresh-silence specificity recorded (36/36 expected silent); overbroad rate > 0.10 with probes>0; closure medians <= 0.20; B-NO-REPAIR success 0.0 with guard fired 36/36 (diagnostic).
null_control.failure_policy: Any false-firing guard -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Insensitive overbroad -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Cold-nominal drift -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (substrate changed, never a scientific negative). Reuse-nominal drift (V-DRIFT-REUSE) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (fail-safe sequencing pin; genuine repair failures exempt by construction). Registry-equivalence break (V-REG-EQUIV) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (treatment identity violated, never a negative). V-CLOSURE failure -> attribution INVALID only. Breadth/recurrence diagnostics never gate.

decision_rule: Per class c in {P1-ENDPOINT,P2-STRUCTURE,P3-PERMISSION}, n=12 valid trials. functional_ok := repair_success>=0.80 AND wilson_lower>=0.60 AND contamination<=0.10 (over 48 unaffected probes) AND write_set_max<=1 AND guard_fire>=0.80 (same bars as the parent packet). For each of 12 cells (class x L in {2,3} x boundary in {inclusive, NOARG}): R := median(reuse_episode_s)/median(cold_episode_s); BFCI := family-wise Bonferroni bootstrap CI at level 1-0.05/12 (B=10000, frozen seeds) with 95% CI (B=2000) reported as diagnostic. Cell verdict: UNKNOWN if R or BFCI missing; WIN if R<1.00 AND BFCI_upper<1.00; LOSS if R>=1.00 AND BFCI_lower>=1.00; else MARGINAL. Class verdict (first match): FUNCTIONAL-FAIL if !functional_ok; COST-UNKNOWN if any cell UNKNOWN; PRICED-DEFICIT if any cell LOSS; PRICED-WIN if all cells WIN; else PRICED-MARGINAL. Aggregate (first match): FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL if any class FUNCTIONAL-FAIL; INCONCLUSIVE if any class COST-UNKNOWN; PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED if any class PRICED-DEFICIT; SUPPORTS if all classes PRICED-WIN; else INCONCLUSIVE (marginal straddle: no re-admit, no permanent drop, thread parked). Any tripped validity gate (V0..V15, V-DRIFT-*, V-REG-EQUIV, V-TIMING) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (status; outcome INCONCLUSIVE; never a negative). Strict inequality throughout: 1.00 is never a win. All five aggregates {SUPPORTS, PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED, FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL, INCONCLUSIVE-via-UNKNOWN, INCONCLUSIVE-via-MARGINAL} plus MEASUREMENT_INVALID are demonstrated reachable by pure synthetic probes at DESIGN.
product_consequence_positive: SUPPORTS (all 12 cells robust reuse wins with valid gates) RE-ADMITS reuse-based localized repair to the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story WITH honest denominators (shipped unit counter + dual-boundary latency with family-wise CIs + breadth/recurrence scaling + tie-set attribution). No code promotion (runtime lane; no kernel change; carrier byte-identical; harness repair only). B3 real model-call/token economics remains an explicit recorded blocker for any flagship product-economics claim.
product_consequence_negative: PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED (any robust LOSS cell with valid gates) PERMANENTLY DROPS reuse-based localized repair from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story on this substrate/carrier/classes/counter, with no further L-sweeps (mandate stop trigger fires; the drop is now licensed because the known removable tax was removed by measurement and the deficit persisted robustly). FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL (broken functional/locality soundness) is a bounded mechanism concern: no re-admit, no permanent drop. INCONCLUSIVE (marginal straddle or missing/unknown) parks the thread: no re-admit, no permanent drop. C-DELTA-REPAIR itself stays EXPERIMENTAL bounded to functional/locality soundness unless FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL. No promotion in any non-SUPPORTS branch.
estimated_cost: CPU-only, stdlib-only, no downloads, no external API spend. No calibration workload. 36 trials x (2 warmups + 5 timed episodes + literal + norepair controls) on an in-process localhost server plus NC trials: ~15-60 minutes wall clock, negligible memory. No credential, model, browser or network dependency. B3 model economics unsatisfiable on this substrate by construction; priced in counters only with the blocker recorded. Bootstrap B_BONF=10000 over n=12 medians is trivial pure computation.
expected_information_gain: Terminal and decision-changing in both directions; this packet executes the exact repair-gated re-test the parent verdict and the Global Research Director mandate prescribe, and FORCES the re-admission vs permanent-drop resolution the parent explicitly left pending (parent: no re-admission, no permanent drop). The parent proved the as-implemented deficit (six ratios 1.0235-1.2463, all CI95 above 1.00) but localized it entirely to a removable one-line harness artifact (S-REGISTRY-BUILD 39.2x; equalizing that one phase flips all ratios below 1.00 as a diagnostic, not a measurement). This design removes that tax BY MEASUREMENT (single bulk replace, content-pinned identical), repairs the frozen driver gate defect ((m or 1.0) idiom -> explicit is-None checks with 0.0/0.10 boundary coverage), hardens the decision against near-1.00 fragility (Bonferroni family-wise CIs gate both WIN and DROP; marginal straddles park instead of dropping), fixes all ten parent audit required-fixes RF-1..RF-10 by construction (ceiling honesty, tie-set attribution with net-vs-gross semantics, no metric nulls/renames, correct contamination denominator, gate idiom + preflight coverage, complete freeze set incl. __init__.py, disclosed B-NO-REPAIR vacuity, symmetric CI-gated asymmetry), and adds the two mandate scaling questions (breadth n=1,2,5 measuring both authorized repairs; derived recurrence N*) as ungated diagnostics. SUPPORTS re-admits localized repair to C-PRODUCT-ECON with honest denominators; a robust LOSS makes the drop permanent and stops the thread (bounded stop); a straddle parks it. No existing packet provides the no-tax measurement.
